en.title: Mosque Balance Sheet Template
en.issuing_body: Form in actual use in ปทุมธานี (originating drafting authority not precisely known)
en.summary: A balance sheet template as of 30 December showing a mosque's assets (cash, bank deposits, etc.), used alongside the cash book as part of the annual financial report.
